commit_message: Add ADR 0122 Project Rust spatial audio requests
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0122 spatial audio mixer and authoring UX
pr_body: Continues ADR 0122 on the current-main v3 branch. Adds an additive generation-checked Project Rust spatial sound-effect request while preserving the existing 2D PlaySoundEffect command, resolves source transforms through the host, and keeps backend voice identity engine-owned. The previously migrated spatial-audio foundation remains affected-validated; Editor authoring/audition/gizmo work and final Visual Validation remain before ADR acceptance.
